dishes.name: Ahle Wurst
dishes.desc: Hard air-dried pork sausage from North Hesse, with protected origin status. Sliced thick and eaten on bread.

dishes.name: Weckewerk
dishes.desc: Cooked sausage of bread rolls, pork and spices, sliced and fried crisp. A classic North Hessian farm breakfast, served with pickles.

dishes.name: Speckkuchen
dishes.desc: Bacon tart on yeast dough, baked in North Hesse and eaten warm. A simple local baker's staple.

dishes.name: Schwälmer Salzkuchen
dishes.desc: Flat yeast bread topped with cream, egg and bacon, baked in the Schwalm region. A local festive bread, now found in bakeries too.

dishes.name: Diebchen
dishes.desc: Potato dumplings stuffed with meat or bacon, served with bacon sauce. A simple North Hessian village dish.
